title: geranium alternans
intro: Geranium alternans, commonly known as Red Sage, is a plant species belonging to the Geraniaceae family. The health benefits of Geranium alternans include its potential to reduce inflammation, alleviate anxiety and stress, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of Geranium alternans include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
